This file guides Claude Code in this repository. TD Studios’ luxury website is a Next.js 15.5.4 App Router app with TypeScript, synced with v0.app and deployed on Vercel. It features premium glassmorphism design, analytics, and OpenAI ChatKit support.

## Stack and structure
TypeScript strict mode; Supabase/PostgreSQL; Tailwind CSS 3.4.17; Radix UI/shadcn (New York, RSC); pnpm 10.15.1; Geist Sans/Mono; Lucide React; Vercel Analytics; Vitest and Playwright.

- `app/`: routes, `globals.css`, `layout.tsx` (StickyHeader, Footer, analytics, mobile viewport fixes), `page.tsx`
- Routes: `/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`
- API: `contact/` (POST, Resend), `chatkit/session/` (POST, OpenAI), `intake/` (POST, Supabase)
- `components/`: reusable UI; `ui/`: shadcn components; `lib/`: utilities, analytics, A/B testing; `public/`: assets; `styles/`; `tests/`: E2E tests
- Key components: `sticky-header.tsx`, `nav.tsx`, `footer.tsx`, `glass-card.tsx`, `frosted-button.tsx`, `page-title.tsx`, `section.tsx`, `json-ld.tsx`, `calendly-embed.tsx`, `logo.tsx`, `analytics-provider.tsx`, `ab-test-wrapper.tsx`, `theme-provider.tsx`
- See [ROUTES.md](./ROUTES.md) and [docs/architecture-map.json](./docs/architecture-map.json).

## Design and functionality
Dark-first luxury aesthetic: OKLCH tokens, black background (`oklch(0.145 0 0`), white text, neutral glass cards (70% opacity, backdrop blur), 0.625rem default radius. Mobile-first responsive design, light/dark themes, iOS Safari viewport fixes in `layout.tsx`, accessible focus/hover states, Lucide icons. Use Tailwind utilities and CVA variants.

Analytics covers page views, clicks, forms, downloads, bookings, scroll depth, time on page, and CTA performance. A/B testing supports variants, traffic allocation, activation, and conversion tracking. SEO includes canonical URLs, OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD. `/pricing` merged into `/faq`; `/services` split into `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`.

## Environment
Create `.env.local` from `.env.local.example`:
`RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME` (auto-injected), `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE` (e.g., `CLIENT_THEBODYBOUTIQUE_PASSCODE`).

Client portals use `jose` JWTs signed with `JWT_SECRET`; unique client passcodes are environment variables. Sign-in: `/[client]/signin`; protected portal: `/clients/[client]`.

## Commands
```sh
pnpm dev            # Start development server (Next.js dev mode on port 3000)
pnpm serve          # Start production server on port 3000 (after building)
pnpm build          # Build for production using Next.js
pnpm lint           # Run Next.js linting with ESLint
pnpm typecheck      # Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files
pnpm ci:verify      # Run full CI verification (lint + typecheck + test)
pnpm report:types   # Generate type error report using custom script
pnpm scan:secrets   # Scan entire codebase for potential secrets using secretlint
pnpm scan:secrets:staged  # Scan only staged git files for secrets (used by pre-commit hook)
pnpm test           # Run unit tests with Vitest (single run)
pnpm test:watch     # Run Vitest in watch mode for development
pnpm test:jest      # Run Jest tests (if applicable)
npx playwright test # Run Playwright end-to-end tests
npx playwright test --ui # Run tests with UI mode for debugging
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts # Run specific test file
pnpm lh:routes      # Run Lighthouse audits on routes using custom script
```

Vitest uses jsdom, `tests/setup.ts`, `vitest.config.ts` (`@/` → root), `*.spec.ts?(x)`, and excludes Playwright tests (`**/mobile-layout.spec.ts`, `**/playwright/**`); `passWithNoTests: false`. Playwright tests in `tests/` cover mobile layout, viewport, touch targets, parallax and text; screenshots in `tests/screenshots/`.

## Configuration and workflow
ESLint errors and TypeScript build errors are ignored during builds for deployment compatibility/v0.app integration. Images: `i.imgur.com`, `via.placeholder.com`, `cdn.platform.openai.com`, `tdstudiosny.com`; AVIF/WebP responsive optimization. Permanent 301 redirect: `www.tdstudiosny.com` → `tdstudiosny.com`. TypeScript: ES2017, strict, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch`, `@/*` root alias.

Repository sync: v0.app → GitHub → Vercel; major changes primarily via v0.app. Project: https://v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7. Run `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Husky hooks install via postinstall: pre-commit scans staged files for secrets; pre-push blocks direct pushes to `main` and runs a full secret scan outside CI. Branch protection requires feature branches and PRs. secretlint uses `<REDACTED_USER>/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend`.

## Practices
Use strict interfaces, `@/*` imports, `"use client"` where needed, PascalCase components/kebab-case files, props interfaces, accessible semantic HTML/ARIA/keyboard support, lazy loading, code splitting, and optimized re-renders. API endpoints: contact submits via Resend; ChatKit creates/continues sessions via OpenAI; intake stores qualified leads in Supabase. Navigation: WORK · WEB · DEV · SOCIAL · DESIGN · PROCESS · RESOURCES · FAQ · CONTACT; footer: Support · Legal · Book.

UX documentation covers audits, user journeys, luxury-brand standards, and performance.
